Definition: to course (like a beast of prey); by implication, to seek greedily
BiblicalUsage: 1) to run, run about, rush, run to and fro, be eager or greedy or thirsty; 1a) (Qal) roving, ranging, longing, rush out upon (participle); 1b) (Hithpalpel) to rush to and fro, rush back and forth
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
